subject.title: feat: add jsonl support to memory indexer

question: Should builtin `memorySearch.extraPaths` support arbitrary JSONL logs, or should raw message logs remain handled by session-memory, QMD, a converter, or a plugin workflow?
rationale: The code change is feasible but changes memory visibility and raw-log security semantics, while VISION.md prefers lean core and plugin-owned optional capabilities unless a core seam is missing.

options.title: Decide Boundary First
options.body: Keep this issue open for maintainer product/security decision before any automated implementation attempts native JSONL ingestion.

options.title: Implement Native JSONL
options.body: Accept builtin support and require a parser/chunker with line mapping, watcher/read support, docs, and privacy-focused tests.

options.title: Document Alternative Workflow
options.body: Decline builtin support and document session-memory, QMD, converter, or plugin-based ingestion as the supported path.

recommendation.title: Decide Boundary First
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for maintainer product/security decision before any automated implementation attempts native JSONL ingestion.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already provided the most concrete maintainer-facing review comment and appears in the relevant memory refactor history.
